label: a2 trial after a reward, early in episode (D1/D2)
explanation: Fires only at D1 and D2 (never at GO), only when the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward==1 holds ~100% of mass), and almost only on trials where the agent chooses a2 (99% of mass). At D1, action is the agent's own upcoming choice, which it may compute (legitimate); the purely observed alternative (D1 after prev_action a2, D2 after choosing a2) gives F1 0.57 vs 0.61, so I recorded the upcoming-choice version. Strongly limited to early episode (trials ~3-50, peak 10-30; silent after ~60) and higher in episodes that start with S2 good. Activation tends to build up over consecutive rewarded a2 trials, which the predicate does not capture, hence low precision (~0.45) despite ~0.98 mass recall. The largest activations are an exception: D2 after an a1 choice following a rewarded a2 streak (rare in count). Does not fire after unrewarded trials, at GO, or on a1 trials generally.
